facts.text: Morgan State University is Maryland's largest HBCU and the only university to have its entire campus designated as a National Treasure by the National Trust for Historic Preservation.

sources.title: About Morgan State - Morgan State University
sources.quote: The only university to have its entire campus, designated as a National Treasure by the National Trust for Historic Preservation, offers a safe and inviting learning environment

sources.title: About Morgan State - Morgan State University
sources.quote: Among the nation's most diverse Historically Black Colleges and Universities, and the largest in Maryland, Morgan seeks to ensure that the doors of higher education are opened as wide as possible
